panel_descriptions: Left-side workflow from initialization to retained candidates.
Right-side explanation of one surrogate-query step.
claim_boundary: The figure describes the DDPG-based surrogate-search workflow and single-query surrogate interaction; actor-critic learning mechanics are reserved for Fig. 3.
caption: Figure 2. Workflow of the DDPG-based surrogate search. The optimization starts by initializing the surrogate-based environment and selecting one preference scenario. Each episode begins from a random descriptor query and then proceeds through repeated surrogate-query steps, in which the actor produces an absolute descriptor query and the guarded surrogate returns the next state and reward. The episode terminates after a fixed query horizon, and the process continues until all episodes and seeds are completed.

main_nodes: Reset episode with a random descriptor query
